issues.description: File I/O on every external stack frame with no memoization or cache
issues.detail: getSourceMap is invoked per-frame during error formatting. Each call does existsSync + readFileSync of the entire module source and parses a (potentially large) base64 inline source map. A single error with N frames in the same file re-reads and re-decodes the same map N times. Memoize by file path (Map<string, SourceMap|undefined>) for the lifetime of the stack parse.

issues.description: Silent swallowing of read errors and absent termination/error invariant
issues.detail: readFileSync and convertSourceMap.fromSource can throw on permission errors, non-UTF8 bytes, or malformed base64 maps. There is no try/catch, so a malformed external module turns a test failure into an unrelated formatter crash. State the invariant: getSourceMap must return SourceMap | undefined and never throw. Wrap in try/catch and return undefined on failure.

issues.description: resolve(from, '..', s) silently changes semantics for absolute sources
issues.detail: The fix changes resolve(s, from) to resolve(from, '..', s). Pathe's resolve treats absolute path segments as restarting the path, so behavior diverges between relative and absolute source entries, and between sources arrays that include 'sourceRoot'. The literate comment is missing: why '..'? Because 'from' is the map URL, not its directory. State that invariant in a comment and add a test for sources containing absolute paths.

issues.description: Fallback '{}' for missing companion map is an under-documented sentinel
issues.detail: Returning the string '{}' to convertSourceMap when the referenced file is missing is clever but undocumented. A reader cannot tell whether '{}' is a valid empty source map representation the library accepts, or a hack. Add a one-line literate comment, or return a typed empty SourceMap object via the library's own helper.

issues.description: Mixing pathe and node:path without stated reason
issues.detail: The file imports resolve from 'pathe' and also import path from 'node:path', then uses path.resolve/path.dirname in the new helper. The two normalize separators differently on Windows; the choice should be deliberate and commented. Prefer pathe consistently for cross-platform map URL handling, or document why node:path is correct here.

issues.description: No test exercising the new getSourceMap path directly
issues.detail: Only a snapshot update demonstrates the fix. The new extractSourcemapFromFile and createConvertSourceMapReadMap helpers deserve unit tests for: inline base64 map, external .map file present, external .map file missing, malformed map, and absolute sources entries. Beware of bugs in the above code; I have only proved it plausible, not tried it on every branch.

review.summary: The fix is RIGOROUS in intent and correctly identifies that external-module frames need a source map lookup that mirrors Vite's. The one-line change in DecodedMap (resolve(from, '..', s)) is the right asymptotic fix but is UNDER-AUDITED: the invariant ("from is the map URL, resolve against its parent directory") is not stated and absolute entries in sources may behave surprisingly. The new getSourceMap callback does synchronous file I/O per frame with no memoization, no error containment, and an undocumented '{}' sentinel — ASYMPTOTICALLY-OK-PRACTICALLY-SLOW for files with deep stacks, and fragile under malformed maps. Add caching, a try/catch with undefined fallback, literate comments for the resolve('..') choice and the '{}' fallback, consistent use of pathe, and unit tests for the four map-shape branches.
